translations.web: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
translations.bsb: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
translations.kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
translations.asv: But the Jews that were disobedient stirred up the souls of the Gentiles, and made them evil affected against the brethren.
